description: Sends one mono signal to eight outputs standing for the eight corners of a cube, with knobs for its position in all three directions and a send and return loop on the way

params.text: Moves the source along the first axis; fully anticlockwise it favours jacks 1, 3, 5 and 7, fully clockwise jacks 2, 4, 6 and 8
Moves the source along the second axis; fully anticlockwise it favours jacks 1 to 4, fully clockwise jacks 5 to 8
Moves the source along the third axis; fully clockwise it favours jacks 1, 2, 5 and 6, fully anticlockwise jacks 3, 4, 7 and 8
Sets the gain applied to the input before everything else, 0% to 100%
Filters the signal after the level: anticlockwise a two-pole low-pass sweeping from 22000Hz down to 20Hz, clockwise a two-pole high-pass from 10Hz up to 8000Hz, no filter in the middle
Sets how much of the signal is copied to the send jack, 0% to 100%

inputs.text: The mono signal to be placed
Added to the X knob, a fifth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Added to the Y knob, a fifth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Added to the Z knob, a fifth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
Added to the FILTER knob, a fifth of its travel per volt; the total is held between the two ends of it
A signal added into the placed output, going to the four odd-numbered corners at the gain the position gives them
A signal added into the placed output, going to the four even-numbered corners at the gain the position gives them

outputs.text: The corner favoured by X and Y fully anticlockwise and Z fully clockwise
The corner favoured by X fully clockwise, Y fully anticlockwise and Z fully clockwise
The corner favoured by X, Y and Z all fully anticlockwise
The corner favoured by X fully clockwise and Y and Z fully anticlockwise
The corner favoured by X fully anticlockwise and Y and Z fully clockwise
The corner favoured by X, Y and Z all fully clockwise
The corner favoured by X fully anticlockwise, Y fully clockwise and Z fully anticlockwise
The corner favoured by X and Y fully clockwise and Z fully anticlockwise
The signal at the send level; by default it is taken after the LEVEL knob, and the menu can move it in front

notes: every corner carries some of the signal at every setting. The gain falls off with the distance to that corner, and the eight gains are scaled so their squares add to one.
the two return jacks are summed into the corner outputs at the same gains the source is given, so a return is placed where the source is rather than spread evenly.
menu: Send Pre-Level — takes the send from the input jack directly rather than after the LEVEL knob
